ensure_fitted_raise: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch model are fitted or raise a ValueError
ensure_fitted_warn: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch model are fitted and log a warning if not
review_ensure_fitted: review the ensure_fitted function to understand how it validates ScaleFactor modules in a model
refactor_ensure_fitted: refactor the ensure_fitted function to support custom error messages for unfitted scale factors
test_ensure_fitted: test the ensure_fitted function with a model containing unfitted ScaleFactor modules
